fields.reasoning: Finding f1 is a wording mismatch, not a behaviour defect. internal/api/daemon_projects.go:429 runs daemonCommitUntracked and daemonMergeModelPRs only when modelNetDue: first poll, then once a minute, under a 30s per-program bound. Commit e8e289be4 added that on purpose: a stalled ls-remote/fetch/push/gh on every 5s poll held up every project's poll and spent the gh token each tick, the same reason the self-update fetch is throttled. Reverting it to every tick would bring that back. The change set's intent (nothing left uncommitted on main) is still met with a one-minute delay, since orphans are picked up on start and within a minute after. So the leaf's text, not the code, should change; three review cycles failed only because the leaf still promises every tick.
fields.statement: Keep the throttle from e8e289be4 and change leaf @{01M76FAA7V5KJWJPQSF2X7PCMD} instead: its statement should say the daemon commits orphan entries on its first poll and then at most once a minute (modelNetEvery), each git/gh call bounded by modelNetTimeout, not 'on each tick'; the acceptance's daemon test asserts a due round (first poll) does the commit, not every tick
